provenance_requirements: record DOI or stable provider URL
record provider name and retrieval date
store local file hash when PDF or HTML snapshot is captured
keep licensed full text outside Git
link each extract to one source-basis record and one extraction record
prohibited_use: proof of current site-specific operating truth
extraction_rules: extract structural pattern claims only as falsifiable priors
extract anti-triggers and falsification conditions explicitly
do not paraphrase literature into local truth
